title: CSV export drops leading zeros from product codes
body:
When a product code starts with zero, the CSV export removes the zero.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Create a product with code `007`.
2. Run `python3 -m shop.export --format csv`.
3. Open `exports/products.csv`.

## Expected behavior

The CSV cell holds "007".

## Actual behavior

The CSV cell holds "7".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exporting code `007` writes `007` to the CSV file.
- [ ] Codes without a leading zero are unchanged.
- [ ] `pytest tests/test_export.py` passes.
- [ ] The export feels faster.

Relevant code: `src/shop/export.py` line 88.
